slides: Welcome back. Now type two of trial and error, minimum and maximum.

slides.say: Minimum and maximum questions are about ranges. What's the smallest possible value, and what's the biggest?
We look at what makes the answer smaller or bigger. That helps us choose what to try. So we need far fewer tries.

slides.say: By the way, minimum and maximum isn't only this lesson. It comes back all over the quantitative section. In geometry, in overlap problems later on, and in many other questions. So we'll use this way of thinking again and again.
